comment: Three things in this module do not match what the panel and the README promise. The chorus depth trimmer is configured and drawn but appears in no expression outside the widget, so it is dead (Water.cpp:41, 285). The three chorus LFOs are meant to be 120 and 240 degrees apart, but the offsets are written as std::sin(2*M_PI*(p - 120)) and (p - 240) at Water.cpp:187-193, and subtracting a whole number of cycles from a normalised phase leaves the three sines identical. The internal chorus feedback is multiplied by a variable passed into the delay function by value and never written back (Water.cpp:86-137), so it stays at zero. The module also declares a second output for testing the tremolo LFO which has no jack on the panel.
